structured.answer: Seems like every saving has two parts, the product (like my קרן השתלמות or a securities account) and what it's invested in (like the S&P 500), so I'd look at my קרן השתלמות and an S&P 500 fund. But the page gave me no fees, no shekel figures and no first step.

stuck.why: The cards I cared most about were cut off. I only saw the bottoms of them, so I don't know what the options were.
It recommends 'קרן חדשה מקיפה', which I've never heard of. Not sure if it's for me or if I already have it.
Lots of cards that look alike and no way to tell which is better: no numbers, no fees, no returns.

skimmed: 'במה הכסף מושקע' cards (מזומן שקלי, קרן כספית, מק"מ, אג"ח, מסלול כללי)

findings.what: No numbers at all: no fees, no returns, nothing in shekels to compare options with
The self-directed section (the one that fits me) is cut off between screens, so I couldn't read its cards
The starting suggestion uses jargon ('קרן חדשה מקיפה') with no plain explanation up front
Lots of index cards that look the same, with no hint which one a beginner should pick
Terms like מק"מ and 'מנוטרלת' are thrown in without explanation
